terms.comment: prōnōmen relātīvum: quī, quae, quod (Traupman 224). A relative clause refers back to its antecedent (see antecedent).

phrases.english: What kind of pronoun? — A relative pronoun.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 224, p. 242, p. 248.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
